certificates.name: Digital Egypt Pioneers Program - React Frontend Web Developer
certificates.text: Completed the Digital Egypt Pioneers Program (DEPI) as a React Frontend Web Developer. This intensive training program ran from June to December 2025 and covered core learning outcomes in modern React development, component architecture, state management, and responsive web design. Sponsored by Ministry of Communications and Information Technology of Egypt.
